title: Platform Administration & Persona Certification
outcome: NoorPath platform administrators can govern operator approval state from one command centre, with auditable version-checked decisions, while demo customer, operator and platform identities prove deny-by-default persona boundaries without depending on the deferred customer OTP provider.
actor: NoorPath platform administrators governing operator access and product owners certifying persona-level access.
modules: Operators remains authoritative for operator state, membership, permissions and approval eligibility.
The API owns platform-administrator authorization, lifecycle decisions, optimistic concurrency and append-only operator decision audit.
The web application extends the existing NoorPath protected-account visual language with a platform administration command centre.
Existing customer and operator journeys remain authoritative; VS-34 adds persona-level certification rather than duplicating their workflows.
routes: Platform administrator -> /admin -> operator lifecycle overview and queue
Platform administrator -> operator decision -> approved/rejected/suspended/deactivated governed transition
Platform administrator -> operator history -> append-only lifecycle evidence
Platform administrator -> publication reviews -> existing /platform/publications workflow
Demo customer/operator/platform identities -> protected access endpoints -> persona boundary certification
acceptance: Only configured Platform Administrator identities can list, inspect or change operator lifecycle state.
Draft, pending approval, approved, rejected, suspended and deactivated operators follow the explicit NoorPath transition policy without shortcut transitions.
Rejection, suspension and deactivation require a bounded auditable reason.
Lifecycle changes are optimistic-concurrency protected and stale decisions return a safe conflict response.
Every accepted lifecycle change records actor account, previous state, target state, operator version, timestamp, correlation identifier and optional reason.
Operator administration access remains deny-by-default unless the operator is Approved and the active member has the explicit operator administration permission.
A demo pending operator is denied operator access before Platform Administrator approval and allowed immediately after approval through the same authority path used by the application.
Demo customer, approved operator and Platform Administrator identities prove their expected account/operator/platform access boundaries without using a production OTP provider.
The /admin command centre exposes operator lifecycle summary, pending-first queue, governed decisions, stale/error feedback and decision history using the existing NoorPath account visual language.
The admin command centre has keyboard-operable controls, visible labels, WCAG 2.2 AA checks, minimum 44px interactive targets and no horizontal overflow at 390px.
Forward-only Operators migration, generated migration metadata and model-snapshot parity are present for lifecycle audit persistence.
Existing customer and operator journey tests remain part of certification so VS-34 cannot regress previously accepted persona workflows.
Customer phone OTP provider configuration and Knowledge Pack work remain explicitly deferred and do not block VS-34 certification.
Production deployment remains separately authorized and is not performed by this slice.
exclusions: Customer phone OTP provider selection, credentials, delivery configuration or production authentication cutover.
Knowledge Pack authoring, ingestion or AI grounding.
Production deployment or changing the currently approved production SHA.
Supplier, airline, hotel, insurance or WhatsApp integrations.
Replacing NoorPath's existing customer or operator visual identity.
